Title: Data Analyst
Description: We are looking for dedicated and talented people who tackle ever-changing challenges, supplier development needs, and cross-functional collaboration with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of manufacturing. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world. Why you’ll love working for Siemens! Freedom and a healthy work-life balance – Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces. Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects. Engaging, challenging, and fast-evolving environment – Work with cutting-edge technology in a global network. Career growth opportunities – Access to local and global mentorship programs and learning platforms. Social responsibility – Contribute to our initiatives focused on education, technology access, and community sustainability. Culture of celebration and recognition – Participate in events, innovation programs, and team-building activities. Bring your ideas to life – Share and implement your innovative solutions and get recognized for your impact. We value diversity – Inclusion and belonging are part of who we are. This position will ensure the efficient collection, processing, analysis, and visualization of data to support business decision-making and optimize processes. Guarantee data quality, accuracy, and consistency across systems and reports. What will you do? Collect, clean, and process data from various sources, ensuring data integrity and quality. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover insights and support decision-making. Create predictive models using machine learning techniques to forecast trends and improve processes. Knowledge of AI techniques (NLP, Computer Vision, Chatbots) for advanced analytics. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements. Design and maintain data pipelines, automating data collection and processing. Conduct data validation and troubleshooting to resolve data-related issues. Document data processes, procedures, and guidelines for consistency. What will you need to succeed? Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field. At least 1 year of experience in data analysis or a related role. Advanced English proficiency. Experience working with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI). Strong knowledge of data analysis techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis. Proficiency in machine learning frameworks. Knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, AWS, Azure). Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Effective communication skills for presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders. Competences: Analytical Thinking Effective Communication Collaboration Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Siemens is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state, or local law. Location: Santa Catarina, Nuevo Leon
ShortDescription: Ensure efficient collection, processing, analysis, and visualization of data to support business decision-making. Additionally, maintain data pipelines and troubleshoot data issues.
TechStack: SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Machine Learning, SAP, Snowflake, AWS, Azure
